brief.question: Rebuild a Proxyman-style network debugging desktop app (traffic list, inspector, cURL/share, repeat, Map Local, Breakpoints, log dashboard) as a Rust + egui POC from the person's description, with no access to the original.
brief.purpose: Learning POC for the person: see how capture, mocking, breakpoint editing and logging fit together.
constraints: Clean room: never open, list, read, run or decompile the target
brief.done_when: cargo build succeeds, --screenshot produces a non-blank window PNG, and all requested feature areas are present and usable.

plan.title: Keep your chosen request in place while live traffic keeps arriving
plan.why: The person wants a selected call to stay selected instead of jumping to every new response.

plan.title: Add JSON, Raw, XML and HTML choices for the response body
plan.why: The person wants a Postman-style response view, with JSON as the default.

plan.title: Build the app and fix any errors
plan.why: A working build is needed before checking the screens.

plan.title: Take pictures of the pinned selection and the response views
plan.why: Confirm the new controls are visible and the layout still reads clearly.

plan.title: Run the final comparison check and write the summary
plan.why: Make sure the program starts, draws and passes the same checks.

handoff: FINAL: Proxzy POC builds (cargo build), 11 tests pass, and rebuild_check reports build passed plus app-screenshot passed (2880x1662), 'This would pass.' The app now detects booted iOS simulators and Android emulators/phones before any certificate action: app/src/devices.rs scans xcrun simctl and adb on a worker thread, and Live Capture shows a Detected devices card with READY/NOT BOOTED pills and a per-device Connect… button. Clicking opens a confirmation modal (Connect and trust / Certificate only / Cancel); iOS uses the clicked UDID with xcrun simctl keychain <UDID> add-root-cert, restarts that simulator and sets the Mac web proxy, while Android uses the clicked adb serial for 10.0.2.2 or the LAN IP and pushes the CA to /sdcard/Download. The Guide has a new 'Connect real traffic from a simulator or emulator' section with two step-by-step columns, manual commands and troubleshooting. PROXZY_DEMO=connect opens the modal for screenshots. Fresh shots: shots/device-live.png, shots/device-guide.png, shots/device-modal.png. Traps: views.rs and rules_ui.rs are textually included into app.rs, so never add mod declarations; never touch /Applications/Proxyman.app; only build inside app/; never start dev servers or watchers. Next move: none required.
